[[CR Belouizdad]] (Cup winner) | league topscorer = [[Mohamed Messaoud]] (19 goals) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | matches = 272 | total goals = 567 | longest wins = | title = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2007–08 Algerian Championnat National|2007–08]] | nextseason = [[2009–10 Algerian Championnat National|2009–10]] }} The '''2008–09 Algerian Championnat National''' was the 47th season of the [[Algerian Championnat National]] since its establishment in 1962. A total of 17 teams contested the league, with [[MC Alger]] as the defending champions. On May 29, 2009, [[ES Sétif]] were crowned champions with two games remaining after beating [[USM El Harrach]] 2-1.{{cite web|url=http://www.dzfoot.com/article-1494-d1-setif-champion-d-algerie-br-un-4e-titre-national.php |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130121215602/http://www.dzfoot.com/article-1494-d1-setif-champion-d-algerie-br-un-4e-titre-national.php |url-status=dead |archive-date=January 21, 2013 |title=D1 : Sétif Champion d'Algérie |publisher=DZFoot |date=May 29, 2009 |access-date=September 25, 2012 |language=fr }} ==RCK & FAF case== On August 20, 2008, the [[Court of Arbitration for Sport]] in [[Lausanne]] forced the club's integration into the Algerian first division championship for the 2008-09 season while investigating the conflict between the [[Algerian Football Federation]] (FAF) and the club. This case is linked to the arbitrary decision taken by the FAF to impose a sanction against the RCK without having full evidence in the case.{{cite web |url=https://www.djazairess.com/fr/infosoir/88573 |title=Affaire RCK-FAF / Le TAS conforte de nouveau le RC Kouba |website=djazairess.com |date=30 September 2008 |accessdate=4 September 2021 |archive-date=4 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210904193924/https://www.djazairess.com/fr/infosoir/88573 |url-status=live }}{{cite web |url=https://www.dzfoot.com/football-en-algerie/le-tas-donne-definitivement-raison-a-koubalusmh-el-harrach-en-d2-11353.html |title=Le TAS donne definitivement raison à Kouba (L'USMH El Harrach en D2 ?) |website=dzfoot.com |date=29 September 2008 |accessdate=4 September 2021 |archive-date=4 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210904193925/https://www.dzfoot.com/football-en-algerie/le-tas-donne-definitivement-raison-a-koubalusmh-el-harrach-en-d2-11353.html |url-status=live }} The sanction carries a match lost automatically against USM El Harrach and three points penalty for having played a player under a false identity during the RC Kouba & [[USM El Harrach]] match counting for the 37th and penultimate day of the Algerian Division 2 [[2007–08 Algerian Championnat National 2|season 2007–08]] (ended 0-0). This resulted in RC Kouba resetting the 5th position and the rise of USM El Harrach to 3rd position in the general classification, synonymous with accession to the Algerian first division. Thus and although the club has lodged appeals with the Algerian sports authorities, this decision will not be annulled, which leads the club to seize the international CAS, while the first division matches have already started. Finally, the CAS decided to cancel the sanction taken by the FAF and ordered the integration of the club into the first division for the 2008–09 season, then approved the club's accession on September 29, 20086. The change was ratified by the FAF on October 26, 20087, and the 2008–09 Algerian Championnat National was played with 17 clubs.{{cite web
